package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/course"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// CourseRelationsHandler handles tag/tech relations.
type CourseRelationsHandler struct {
	Validator        *validator.Validate
	UpdateTagsUC     course.UpdateCourseTags
	UpdateTechsUC    course.UpdateCourseTechs
	AddModuleUC      course.AddCourseModule
	ReplaceModulesUC course.ReplaceCourseModules
	DeleteModuleUC   course.DeleteCourseModule
}

// UpdateTags handles PUT /course-relations/update-tags/{courseID}.
func (h CourseRelationsHandler) UpdateTags(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	var req struct {
		TagIDs []int `json:"tag_ids" validate:"omitempty,dive,min=1"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.UpdateTagsUC.Handle(r.Context(), courseID, req.TagIDs); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// UpdateTechs handles PUT /course-relations/update-techs/{courseID}.
func (h CourseRelationsHandler) UpdateTechs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	var req struct {
		TechIDs []int `json:"tech_ids" validate:"omitempty,dive,min=1"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.UpdateTechsUC.Handle(r.Context(), courseID, req.TechIDs); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// AddModule handles POST /course-relations/add-module/{courseID}.
func (h CourseRelationsHandler) AddModule(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	var req struct {
		ModuleID string `json:"module_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		Order    int    `json:"order" validate:"min=-32768,max=32767"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.AddModuleUC.Handle(r.Context(), course.AddCourseModuleInput{
		CourseID: courseID,
		ModuleID: req.ModuleID,
		Order:    req.Order,
	}); err != nil {
		writeCourseRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// ReplaceModules handles PUT /course-relations/replace-modules/{courseID}.
func (h CourseRelationsHandler) ReplaceModules(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req replaceCatalogRelationsRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if err := h.ReplaceModulesUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "courseID"), mapCatalogRelationOrder(req)); err != nil {
		writeCourseRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// DeleteModule handles DELETE /course-relations/delete-module/{courseID}/{moduleID}.
func (h CourseRelationsHandler) DeleteModule(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	moduleID := chi.URLParam(r, "moduleID")
	if err := h.DeleteModuleUC.Handle(r.Context(), courseID, moduleID); err != nil {
		writeCourseRelationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func writeCourseRelationError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrConflict {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrValidation {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}
